---
title: "Getting Started with R and JupyterLab on DNAnexus"
subtitle: "MCPS training"
---

Welcome to the **MCPS DNAnexus onboarding tutorial**.

This short, self-paced tutorial will show you how to use DNAnexus for R-based analysis in JupyterLab. It is designed for people who are new to DNAnexus and do **not** require command-line experience.

::: {.callout-important}
## Data safety

This tutorial uses training data. In real MCPS projects, **individual-level research data must remain within the approved DNAnexus environment unless you have explicit permission to export it**.
:::

## What you will learn

By the end of the tutorial you will be able to:

- find your DNAnexus project and assigned workspace;
- start an R-based JupyterLab environment;
- understand the difference between persistent project storage and temporary compute;
- open and use a persistent **`[DX]` DNAnexus Notebook**;
- read data stored in the project from R;
- save your analysis and its outputs;
- terminate JupyterLab when you finish; and
- return later and continue your work.

## The workflow

> **Project → JupyterLab → `[DX]` notebook → R analysis → Save → Terminate**

Work through the tutorial in order, and complete the hands-on exercises in the accompanying `getting-started.ipynb` notebook when instructed.
